Page 1 of 4 Version 1.04 – Clarification edits approved in Planning 11/25/2025 – Effective date – 2/01/2026 RESIDENTIAL FEE SCHEDULE FOR THE VILLAGE OF HARVEYSBURG BUILDING INSPECTION DEPARTMENT Effective Date: February 1, 2026 How to Calculate Fees : To determine fees, add the appropriate charges from the sections below. Multiply the total amount of fees by 1% to determine the State Surcharge Fee. Application Fee + Other Total Fees + Surcharge= Total. Example-Deck= $50 (Application Fee) + $105(Building Fee)+$1.05 (1% surcharge)=$156.05. If you added Electric to the Deck above: $70.00 (Electric Min) +$.70 (1%) =$70.70, added to the $156.05 for a grand total of $226.75.
